prose: The Information reports DeepSeek doubled the size of its latest funding round - nearly $16 billion this month - in part because surging black-market prices for Nvidia Blackwell chips raised the cost of its compute plans, with Chinese state-owned investors representing 27 percent of the round.
highlights: DeepSeek's latest round nearly doubled to ~$16B
Driver: surging black-market Nvidia Blackwell prices
Chinese state-owned investors took 27% of the round
Basis: Techmeme summary; The Information paywalled (HTTP 403)
